Spartanburg, South Carolina · eat

Restaurants in Spartanburg for cyclists

Where to eat in Spartanburg the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

For: The Assault on Mt. Mitchell.

Restaurants in Spartanburg for cyclists, listed

  1. Sophia's Italian Restaurant

    Italian · 155 W Main St, Spartanburg, SC 29306

    Hand-rolled pasta steps from Morgan Square; dinner only, Monday to Saturday 5 to 10.

  2. Islas on the Square

    Seafood · 113 North Church Street, Spartanburg, SC 29306

    Coastal seafood on Church Street; dinner Tuesday to Saturday, closed Sunday and Monday.

  3. The Kennedy

    Contemporary American / steakhouse · East Kennedy Street, downtown Spartanburg, SC

    Chef-driven dinner spot a few blocks from Morgan Square.

  4. Cribbs Kitchen

    Southern, burgers · West Main Street, downtown Spartanburg, SC

    Casual downtown standby for a post-ride burger.

  5. Little River Coffee Bar

    Coffee · Downtown Spartanburg, SC

    Local roaster's downtown coffee bar for the early start.
